decks.name: Akali
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set custom. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Akali
hero.specialAbility:
AFTER COMBAT: If Akali was the attacker move her up to 2 spaces. Then, if she shares no zones with the opposing fighter, flip this card.
(If you have other AFTER COMBAT effects, choose the order).
FLIPPED SIDE (MOVE 4): Next time Akali attacks, double all combat damage she would deal. After the combat, flip this card (even if Akali dealt no damage).
hero.quote: We're gonna do this my way...

cards.title: Perfect Execution
cards.duringText: If you would lose the combat, this card's value is 6 instead.

cards.title: Five Point Strike
cards.duringText: You may BOOST this card. If you do, draw 1 card. If you do not, Akali recovers 1 health.

cards.title: Shuriken Flip
cards.afterText: Move Akali up to 3 spaces. If you lost the combat, draw 1 card.

cards.title: I Am My Own Master
cards.afterText: If you won the combat, choose a card in your discard pile and shuffle it into your deck.

cards.title: Twilight Shroud
cards.afterText: Place Akali in any other space in her zone. Draw 1 card.

cards.title: Let's Make This Quick
cards.basicText: Move Akali up to 3 spaces. She may move through opposing fighters. Gain 1 action.

cards.title: Akali's Kitchen
cards.basicText: Akali recovers 2 health. If she shares no zones with any opposing fightes, draw 2 cards.

cards.title: Pruning the Tree
cards.afterText: If you lost the combat, your opponent discards 1 card.

cards.title: Vault
cards.afterText: Move Akali up to 4 spaces. She may move through opposing fighters. Then, deal 1 damage to each opposing fighter she moved through.

cards.title: You're Scared? Good to Know
cards.afterText: The opponent may show you their hand. If they do not, draw 1 card.

cards.title: Feint
cards.immediateText: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.

cards.title: Momentous Shift
cards.duringText: If Akali started this turn in a different space, this card's value is 5 instead.

cards.title: Ninjitsu
cards.afterText: Place Akali in any space.

decks.name: Briar
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set custom. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Briar
hero.specialAbility:
FRENESÍ SANGUINARIO
Briar empieza CONTENIDA (movimiento 2). Al comienzo de tu turno puedes entrar en FRENESÍ, o salir de él descartando 2 cartas.
EN FRENESÍ: Briar tiene movimiento 3 y el valor de sus ataques aumenta en 2. No puedes maniobrar si Briar puede atacar, y al maniobrar Briar debe acabar más cerca de un luchador oponente.

cards.title: Otro mordisquito
cards.duringText: Si el luchador oponente tiene 8 de vida o menos, el valor de esta carta aumenta en 2.

cards.title: A la yugular
cards.afterText: Puedes colocar a Briar en una casilla adyacente al luchador oponente.

cards.title: Desgarro voraz
cards.duringText: Puedes POTENCIAR esta carta.
cards.afterText: Si ganaste el combate, roba 1 carta.

cards.title: Hambre insaciable
cards.afterText: Si atacaste, roba 2 cartas. Si defendiste, roba 1 carta.

cards.title: ¡Tengo hambre!
cards.immediateText: Cancela todos los efectos de la carta de tu oponente.

cards.title: Herida abierta
cards.afterText: Si atacaste, inflige 2 de daño al luchador contrario. Si defendiste, recupera 1 vida.

cards.title: No te vayas
cards.immediateText: El luchador contrario no puede abandonar su casilla durante el resto de este turno.

cards.title: Duele… pero me gusta
cards.afterText: Roba tantas cartas como daño haya recibido Briar en este combate (de combate o de efectos).

cards.title: Alarido escalofriante
cards.afterText: Si Briar está en frenesí, puedes hacer que lo abandone. Si lo haces, recupera 2 vidas y mueve a Briar hasta 2 casillas.

cards.title: Hemolito
cards.immediateText: Cancela todos los efectos de la carta de tu oponente.
cards.duringText: Si Briar tenía 8 vidas o menos al comenzar este combate, el valor de esta carta es 6 en lugar de 4.

cards.title: Final sangriento
cards.basicText: Coloca a Briar en una casilla adyacente a un héroe oponente. Briar entra en FRENESÍ. Gana 1 acción.

cards.title: ¿Amigos?
cards.basicText: Roba 3 cartas. Mueve a Briar hasta 3 casillas.

decks.name: Evelynn (Sombra demoníaca)
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set custom. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Evelynn
hero.specialAbility:
SOMBRA DEMONÍACA
Evelynn empieza en SOMBRA. Al final de tu turno, si Evelynn no está en SOMBRA ni adyacente a ningún luchador oponente, vuelve a SOMBRA y, si tiene 7 de vida o menos, recupera 2 de vida.
En SOMBRA, solo los luchadores adyacentes pueden atacar a Evelynn. Cuando Evelynn ataca desde SOMBRA, el valor de su ataque aumenta en 2. Evelynn sale de SOMBRA cuando ataca o recibe daño.

cards.title: Púa de odio
cards.afterText: Si atacaste desde SOMBRA, inflige 2 de daño al luchador oponente.

cards.title: Latigazo
cards.afterText: Roba 1 carta. Si atacaste desde SOMBRA, gana 1 acción.

cards.title: Hacedora de viudas
cards.duringText: Si atacas a un luchador con 6 de vida o menos, el valor de esta carta es 7.
cards.afterText: Mueve a Evelynn hasta 4 casillas; puede atravesar luchadores oponentes. Roba 1 carta.

cards.title: Ven aquí
cards.afterText: Puedes mover al luchador oponente hasta 2 casillas hacia Evelynn. Si atacaste, roba 1 carta.

cards.title: Abrazo agónico
cards.afterText: Si atacaste, roba 2 cartas. Si defendiste, roba 1 carta.

cards.title: Sonrisa traicionera
cards.immediateText: Cancela todos los efectos de la carta de tu oponente.

cards.title: Entre sombras
cards.afterText: Mueve a Evelynn hasta 3 casillas. Si perdiste el combate, roba 1 carta.

cards.title: Cuerpo de sombra
cards.afterText: Mueve a Evelynn hasta 3 casillas.

cards.title: Sigue mi voz
cards.immediateText: Cancela todos los efectos de la carta de tu oponente.
cards.afterText: Puedes mover al atacante hasta 2 casillas.

cards.title: Seducción
cards.basicText: Elige un luchador oponente. Puedes moverlo hasta 2 casillas hacia Evelynn. En el próximo ataque de Evelynn contra él este turno, el valor de su carta de defensa se reduce en 2. Roba 1 carta. Gana 1 acción.

cards.title: Esencias desesperadas
cards.basicText: Roba 3 cartas. Mueve a Evelynn hasta 2 casillas.

decks.name: Lux
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set custom. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Lux
hero.specialAbility: Inflict the opposing fighter with one stack of divine light for each combat you win (with a maximum of three stacks).
hero.quote: All my light puns will brighten your day.

cards.title: Light Binding
cards.immediateText: The opposing fighter cannot leave their space for the remainder of this turn.
cards.afterText: The opposing fighter gains 1 stack of divine light.

cards.title: Prismatic Barrier
cards.duringText: You may boost this card.
cards.afterText: If you won the combat end the opposing fighter's turn.

cards.title: Lucent Singularity
cards.afterText:
Dispel stacks of divine light to gain the following:
1) The opponent discards 1 card.
2) Add the opponent's BOOST value to this card's value.
3) Ignore the opponent's card value.

cards.title: Final Spark
cards.afterText: Dispel stacks of divine light increasing this card value by 1 for each stack dispelled.

cards.title: Sorceress
cards.afterText: Recover 1 health for each stack of divine light that the opposing fighter has.

cards.title: Dark Cosmic Lux
cards.afterText: Gain divine light equal to the opposing fighter's BOOST value.

cards.title: Crystal Rose
cards.duringText: Cancel all AFTER COMBAT effects on your opponent's card.

cards.title: Evade
cards.afterText: Draw 1 card.

cards.title: Light of Damacia
cards.afterText: Deal 2 damage to the opposing fighter and 1 damage to each other fighter adjacent to Lux.

cards.title: Holy Light
cards.basicText:
Draw 2 cards.
Ongoing: You are considered to win any combat that neither fighter took combat damage.
Discard this card if you didn't attack this turn.

cards.title: Flash
cards.afterText: Move your fighter to any space in your zone.

cards.title: Heal
cards.basicText: Lux and an ally with the lowest health recovers 2 health.

cards.title: Illumination
cards.afterText: You are considered to have won this combat. The opposing fighter randomly discards 1 card.

ruleCards.title: Extra rules
ruleCards.content: After effects that dispel stacks of divine light trigger, you cannot gain any stacks of divine light on a combat victory, until the next combat.

decks.name: Emperor Palpatine
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set custom. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Emperor Palpatine
hero.specialAbility: At the end of your turn, look at the top card of your deck. If an opponent has less cards in hand than its BOOST value, reveal and draw it. Otherwise, place it on top or on bottom of your deck.

cards.title: Force Lightning
cards.duringText: Ignore the value of your opponent's card.
cards.afterText: Your opponent discards a card at random.

cards.title: Let the Hate Flow Through You
cards.afterText: Your opponent discards 2 cards.

cards.title: You Will Die
cards.afterText: Your opponent discards 3 cards.

cards.title: Unlimited Power
cards.basicText: This card’s effects cannot be cancelled.
cards.duringText: Subtract the number of cards in your opponent's hand from the value of this card (to a minimum of 0).

cards.title: Your Feeble Skills Are No Match
cards.duringText:
Add the BOOST value of your opponent's card to this card's value.
You may BOOST this card.

cards.title: You Will Pay the Price for Your Lack of Vision
cards.duringText: If your opponent has 3 or less cards in hand, this card's value is 5.

cards.title: Overconfidence
cards.immediateText: Reveal the top card of your opponent’s deck. They may draw the revealed card. If they do, cancel the effects of their card in this combat. If they do not, they discard the revealed card.

cards.title: Strike Me Down
cards.duringText: Your opponent may BOOST their card.
cards.afterText: If you lost the combat, place a card from your discard pile on top of your deck.

cards.title: Royal Command
cards.immediateText: You may have your fighter exchange spaces with one of your other fighters who is now the defender.

cards.title: All According to My Design
cards.basicText: Choose an opponent. They discard up to 2 cards. For each card they do not discard, place a card from your discard pile on top of your deck.

cards.title: Future Foreseen
cards.basicText: Draw 4 cards, then place 3 cards from your hand on top of your deck in any order.

cards.title: Meditation
cards.basicText:
Emperor Palpatine recovers 2 health.
Until your next turn, your opponents do not draw cards from card effects or character abilities.

cards.title: You Will Call Me Master
cards.basicText:
Choose an opponent. They choose 2 effects:
- They discard a card.
- You move each of their fighters up to 3 spaces.
- Deal 1 damage to each of their fighters.

decks.name: Pantheon
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set custom. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Pantheon
hero.specialAbility:
Mortal Will:
Whenever Pantheon places a card, into the discard pile, he gains a Mortal Will token.

Hand revealing, discard and card stealing effects do not affect him.

cards.title: Grand Starfall
cards.basicText:
Place pantheon on any space available. If he arrives next to an enemy, deal 4 damage to it. (Can only damage one fighter.)
Empowered: Pantheon heals for 3 health OR gains 1 action.

cards.title: Comet Spear
cards.basicText:
Can be played face up. If so, it counts as a ranged attack but has -3 value and ignores the value of your opponents card.
Empowered: Add +2 to this card's value.

cards.title: Shield Vault
cards.basicText: Empowered: Your opponent has 1 less action next turn.
cards.immediateText: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.
cards.afterText: Restore 2 health

cards.title: Aegis Assault
cards.basicText: Empowered: Ignore the value of your attacker's card.
cards.afterText: The excess damage that you have mitigated is dealt to your attacker.

cards.title: Unbreakable Will
cards.basicText:
Choose two:
-gain 1 action
-draw 2 cards
-restore 2 health
Empowered: add +1 to the value of your options. (gain 2 actions, draw 3, heal 3)

cards.title: Mortal Will
cards.basicText:
Choose one:
-draw 3 cards
-move up to 5 spaces, you can move thorugh opposing fighters.
-deal 2-2 damage to an enemy fighter in your zone and to one of its neighbour.
Empowered: Restore 2 health.

cards.title: Atreus
cards.basicText:
Put pantheon on any space. Set your health to 3 and end your turn. You can't play, draw or discard cards until your next turn. At the start of your next turn, set your health to the maximum.
Empowered: You can play cards normally.

cards.title: Momentous Shift
cards.basicText: Empowered: Add +2 to this cards value.
cards.duringText: If your fighter started this turn in a different space, this card's value is 5 instead.

cards.title: Battle Strategist
cards.basicText: Empowered: Move Pantheon up to 4 spaces.
cards.afterText: Draw a card. If you won the combat, draw 2 cards.

cards.title: Skirmish
cards.basicText: Empowered: Move pantheon to any space. (Even if you didn't win)
cards.afterText: If you have won the combat move Pantheon up to 5 spaces.

cards.title: Born to Battle
cards.basicText: Empowered: Ignore the value of the opposng fighter's card.

cards.title: Enemy of Divine Powers
cards.basicText:
If used as an attack: 
-After combat: you gain 1 action.
If used as a defense: 
-After combat: Your opponent's turn ends.
Empowered: Ignore the value of your opponents card.

cards.title: Immortality
cards.basicText:
Choose one: or discard a card to choose two different effects: 
Restore 2 health, or Draw 2 cards, or Put a card from your discard pile in your hand, or Permanently change your movement to 3.
Empowered:  Choose one more different.

ruleCards.title: Extra Rules
ruleCards.content:
Whenever Pantheon places a card into his discard pile by any means, he gains a Mortal Will token, up to 5. When he is at 5 Mortal Will tokens, the next card he plays is going to be empowered. After that he resets to 0 tokens. (And gains 1 when the empovered card is put into discard.) Every card in his deck has an "Empowered:" effect.

His hand can not be revealed, discard and card stealing effects don't affect him.

decks.name: Rick & Morty
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set custom. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Rick Sanchez
hero.specialAbility: If Morty dies, Rick can either spend 1 health or 1 action to revive him, placing Morty adjacent to Rick.

cards.title: I'm Pickle Rick!
cards.duringText: If Morty died in the previous turn, this card's value is 6 instead.
cards.afterText: If Morty did not die in the previous turn, you may move Rick up to 2 spaces

cards.title: Feint
cards.immediateText: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.

cards.title: Rift Resonance
cards.duringText: If you are adjacent to or on 1 Rift, this card’s value is 4. If you are adjacent to or on 2 Rifts, this card’s value is 6. If you are adjacent to or on 3 Rifts, this card’s value is 9.

cards.title: Meeseeks
cards.basicText: Rick may place up to 2 rifts anywhere on the board.

cards.title: Birdperson
cards.basicText: Rick may move anywhere. Place Morty adjacent to Rick.

cards.title: Cybernetic Healing
cards.basicText: Rick heals 3. Gain 1 action

cards.title: Wubba Lubba Dub Dub
cards.afterText: If it is your turn, gain 1 action.

cards.title: Take One for the Team
cards.immediateText: Switch places with Morty. Morty becomes the Defender.

cards.title: Swift Strike
cards.afterText: Move your fighter up to 4 spaces.

cards.title: Mr Poopybutthole
cards.afterText: Draw 1 card.

cards.title: Rift Step
cards.duringText: If Rick started this turn on a rift, this card's value is 5.
cards.afterText: Move Rick to any rift.

cards.title: Missed Me
cards.duringText: If Rick is adjacent to a rift, this card's value is 4
cards.afterText: If you lost, move Rick up to 2 spaces

cards.title: Multiverse Bullshit
cards.duringText: If you are on a rift, this card's value is 7
cards.afterText: Destroy all rifts

cards.title: Microverse Battery
cards.duringText: You may boost this defence. You may also destroy 1 rift to add 2 to this card's value.

ruleCards.title: Portal Gun
ruleCards.content: Whenever Rick moves outside of a Maneuver action, he leaves a Rift at his starting position. Rick and Morty can move through Rifts as though they were adjacent spaces. Rick can have a maximum of 3 Rifts in play at once.

decks.name: Sauron
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set custom. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Sauron
hero.specialAbility:
The One Ring To Rule Them All

At the start of the game, gain control of The One Ring
hero.quote:
"One Ring to rule them all, One Ring to find them, One Ring to bring them all and in the darkness bind them."
                                                  - The One Ring

cards.title: The Eye of Sauron
cards.basicText: Look at your opponent's hand, choose 2 cards from their hand for them to discard.

cards.title: The Corruption of Men
cards.basicText: If you control The One Ring you may have an opponent take control of it to gain an action. If an opponent controls it, then draw 2 cards.

cards.title: Mace of Sauron
cards.immediateText: If you control The One Ring, then cancel all IMMEDIATELY effects on your opponent's card.

cards.title: The One True Ring
cards.afterText: If your opponent controls The One Ring, you may have Sauron take a damage to gain control of The One Ring.

cards.title: Living Death
cards.afterText: If your opponent has less than half health, then restore 1 health.

cards.title: Lidless Gaze
cards.immediateText: Cancel all AFTER COMBAT effects on your opponent's card.
cards.afterText: Your opponent's can't move for the rest of the turn.

cards.title: Fires of Mount Doom
cards.afterText: Deal 1 damage to all fighters in the same zone as Sauron.

cards.title: The Lidless Eye
cards.afterText: If your opponent controls The One Ring, then draw a card.

cards.title: Spirit Form
cards.basicText: Move Sauron up to 4 spaces and draw a card. If your opponent controls The One Ring then draw 2 cards instead.

cards.title: Fiery Inscription
cards.immediateText: If you control The One Ring, then this card's value is 4.

cards.title: In the Darkness Bind Them
cards.immediateText: If your opponent controls The One Ring, then the opposing fighter discards a card.

ruleCards.title: The One Ring
ruleCards.content:
While you control The One Ring you may draw a card at the start of your turn and add +2 to your attacks. 

If an opponets controls The One Ring they may draw a card at the start of their turn and take 1 damage. Damage done this way cannot defeat an opponent.

Whenever combat Damage is dealt to the owner of The One Ring, the player who dealt damage now controls The One Ring.

decks.name: Tahm Kench
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set custom. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Tahm Kench
hero.specialAbility: Once per turn Tahm Kench can dive to another space within his zone or within 5 spaces. This doesn't take an action. If he would land on an occupied space, move that fighter to the nearest option possible and give it a fish marker.
hero.quote: Boy, the world's one river, and I'm its king. Ain't no place I ain't been; ain't no place I can't go again.

cards.title: Tongue Slash
cards.basicText: Give the enemy fighter a Fish marker.
cards.duringText: If you are not adjacent to your opponent, the value of this card is 6
cards.afterText: If your opponent has 3 stacks, they discard a random card. And all 3 markers.

cards.title: An Acquired Taste
cards.basicText:
Give an enemy fighter a fish marker.
Draw 1 card. Gain 1 action.

cards.title: Thick Skin
cards.afterText: Restore health equal to the excess damage you have mitigated.

cards.title: Devour
cards.basicText: Call me king, call me demon. Water forgets the names of the drowned.

cards.title: The Deal
cards.basicText: You can take 1 damage and discard the top card of your opponent's deck. Draw a card. Gain 1 action.

cards.title: Feast
cards.afterText: Draw 1 card.

cards.title: Dive from the Abyss
cards.basicText: After using your power, attacking with this card, doesn't cost any action.
cards.duringText: Give your opponent a fish marker. If your opponent has 3 fish markers, ignore the value of your opponent's card.

cards.title: Move a Little Closer
cards.duringText: Take 3 damage. Deal 3 damage to the enemy fighter. Gain 1 action. Draw 1 card. Give your opponent a Fish marker.

cards.title: Terrifying Eyes
cards.immediateText: Fighters cannot leave their spaces for the rest of the turn.

cards.title: Momentous Shift
cards.duringText: If your fighter started this turn in a different space, this card's value is 5 instead.

cards.title: 15.000 Pounds from Below
cards.duringText: Ignore the value of your opponent's card.
cards.afterText: Take 2 damage.

cards.title: Thrash
cards.immediateText: You may BOOST this card.
cards.afterText: If you won the combat, deal 1 damage to each opposing fighter in Tahm Kench's zone.

ruleCards.title: Extra rules
ruleCards.content:
Tahm Kench is a Large fighter (he can attack up to 2 spaces away).
(With his ability, if he lands on a fighter, the fighter can be moved through opponents.) If the fighter has 3 fish markers they take 1 damage on impact.
Fish markers: if an opponent has 3 stacks of fish markers, some of your cards might have an extra effect. An opponent can have maximum 3 markers. Discarded markers go back to Tahm Kench.

ruleCards.title: Devour
ruleCards.content:
You can only play this card on opponents if there is at least one opponent that has 3 stacks. Choose an enemy hero with 3 stacks or an ally hero. Eat it. Remove it from the board.
At the start of their turn enemies can choose to: skip their turn, or have 1 action and take 5 damage, or have 2 actions and take 8 damage. After they chose, return them on a space of your choosing.
If you ate an ally, at the start of their turn they can choose: skip their turn and restore 8 health, or have 1 action and restore 3 health, or just start their turn normally. Return them to a space of your choosing.

decks.name: Lord Voldemort
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set custom. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Lord Voldemort
hero.specialAbility:
At the beginning of your turn, you may lose 1 health to add a Horcrux to any space in Voldemort's zone.
For Voldemort to be defeated, all Horcruxes in play must first be defeated.

cards.title: Avada Kedavra!
cards.afterText: Voldemort loses 1 health

cards.title: Imperio!
cards.immediateText:
Return your opponent's defence card to their hand. Look at their hand and choose a defense or versatile card for them to play.
(It may be the same card.)

cards.title: Crucio!
cards.duringText: The opponent must BLIND BOOST this attack.

cards.title: There Is Only Power
cards.duringText: You may BLIND BOOST this card.
cards.afterText: If you do not, deal 1 damage to Voldemort.

cards.title: He Who Must Not Be Named
cards.afterText: If you are adjacent to the opposing fighter, deal 1 damage and recover 1 health.

cards.title: The Dark Lord Returns
cards.basicText:
Recover 2 health.
You must then place Voldemort adjacent to any opposing fighter.

cards.title: The Dark Mark
cards.basicText:
You may place any number of all in-play Horcruxes adjacent to Voldemort.
Gain an action.

cards.title: The Elder Wand
cards.basicText: The effects of this card cannot be cancelled.
cards.immediateText: The value of this card is 1 more than the final value of the opponent's card.

cards.title: Darkness Lived in That Boy
cards.afterText: You place Voldemort on any unoccupied space on the board.

cards.title: Unlimited Resources
cards.immediateText: Add +1 to the value of this card for every Horcrux adjacent to Voldemort
cards.afterText: If you lost the combat, deal 1 damage to Voldemort.

cards.title: The Dark Lord's Plans Never Fail
cards.basicText: Choose an opposing fighter and deal 1 damage to them. You may now place them on any space within Voldemort's zone.

cards.title: Feintorio
cards.immediateText: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.
cards.afterText: If you won the combat, draw a card.

cards.title: Skirmixo Kobretto
cards.immediateText: If you won the combat, choose one of the fighters in the combat and move them up to 4 spaces. You may move through opposition fighters.

cards.title: Old Magic
cards.afterText: If you won the combat, add an additional Horcrux to a space outside of Voldemort's current zone.

cards.title: A Fragment of One's Soul
cards.basicText:
You may add 3 Horcruxes to spaces adjacent to Voldemort at the total cost of 1 health.
Gain an action.

ruleCards.title: Horcruxes
ruleCards.content:
All Horcruxes begin off the board. When one is defeated, return it to the box.
Once placed on the board, Horcruxes may be moved as a part of Voldemort's maneuver.
Horcruxes must be dealt damage to be defeated. In that sense, each Horcrux behaves as a 1-health sidekick.
As long as there is one Horcrux on the board, Voldemort's health cannot go below 1.

decks.name: Wanda Maximoff
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set custom. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Wanda Maximoff
hero.specialAbility:
THE SCARLET WITCH:
Wanda is a powerful sorcerer who is able to control her opponent's sidekicks after a certain point. Additionally when the opponent recovers health, Wanda recovers 1 health aswell.
hero.quote:
"You break the rules and become a hero. I do it and I become the enemy"
                                                             --Wanda

cards.title: No More Mutants
cards.afterText: Deal 2 damage to any fighter whose sidekicks are controlled by Wanda.

cards.title: The Westview Incident
cards.immediateText: Prevent all damage other than combat damage.
cards.afterText: If a controlled sidekick played this card move Wanda up to 3 spaces.

cards.title: Queen of Sokovia
cards.duringText: If Wanda played this card, this card's value is 5 instead.
cards.afterText: If a controlled sidekick played this card deal 1 damage to them.

cards.title: The Queen of the Dead
cards.afterText: All of the enemy's sidekicks are now under Wanda's control until the end of her next turn. If there aren't any sidekicks deal 2 damage to the opposing fighter.

cards.title: Reality Warping Abilities
cards.immediateText:
Reveal a card from your hand and choose one:
-This card's effects are the effects of the card you revealed.
-The opponent's card effects are the effects of the card you revealed.

cards.title: I Just Want My Children Back
cards.immediateText: You may swap places with a friendly fighter. That fighter is now the defender.
cards.afterText: If the defender is a controlled sidekick deal 1 damage to the opposing fighter and draw 1 card.

cards.title: Feint
cards.immediateText:
Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.

ruleCards.title: Sidekicks
ruleCards.content: When an enemy sidekick's health is equal or lower than the half of their starting health, Wanda is able to control them and they are considered friendly fighters. If the opposing fighter recovers health, the sidekicks recover equal health even if the card does not say it. If their health has risen higher than the halfway mark they return to the opponent. One health sidekicks are not controllable by health requirements but they can temporarily be controlled by card effects.

ruleCards.title: Odd Health Sidekicks
ruleCards.content: If a sidekick has an odd health every time that the sidekick's health cannot be evenly divided, the halfway point is going to be the smallest of the 2 such as 5 health the halfway poinr for the ability is 2 health. For 7 health it is 3 health, etc.
